definitions.gloss: hot pot dish; one-pot cooking; nabe cuisine
definitions.explanation: A style of Japanese cooking where ingredients such as vegetables, meat, tofu, and noodles are simmered together in a pot at the table. A communal winter staple in Japan.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{鍋料理|なべりょうり}がおいしい。
examples.english: Hot pot dishes are delicious in winter.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}みんなで{鍋料理|なべりょうり}を{囲|かこ}んだ。
examples.english: The whole family gathered around the hot pot.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{地域|ちいき}ごとに{様々|さまざま}な{鍋料理|なべりょうり}がある。
examples.english: In Japan, there are various hot pot dishes unique to each region.

notes:
Composed of {鍋|なべ} (pot) + {料理|りょうり} (cooking, dish). Often shortened to just {鍋|なべ} in casual speech. Hot pot cooking is strongly associated with the colder months and is a quintessential communal meal in Japan — people sit around the pot and serve themselves.

TYPES:
- {寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}: mixed hot pot (various ingredients, light broth)
- {水炊|みずた}き: chicken hot pot (Hakata specialty)
- すき{焼|や}き: sukiyaki (sweetened soy broth)
- しゃぶしゃぶ: shabu-shabu (swishing thin meat slices in broth)
- キムチ{鍋|なべ}: kimchi hot pot
- もつ{鍋|なべ}: offal hot pot (Fukuoka specialty)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The communal aspect of {鍋料理|なべりょうり} is central — eating from the same pot symbolizes closeness. The term {鍋奉行|なべぶぎょう} (hot pot magistrate) humorously refers to a person who takes charge of the cooking at the table.
